name: Protagonist
source:
His former job didn't last long, but he was fortunate enough to get a job as a temporary janitor. He is acquainted with Otoha and Rino. Reiko is his older sister.

[From [url=https://miconisomi.xii.jp/summer/]Miconisomi[/url]]
